case.summary: Case HHG-018 triggered an alert due to out-of-region in-person activity differing from the card's home region, combined with mixed-channel usage and a high-risk model score in decile 10. Historical risk factors included prior confirmed fraud cases on both the card tuple and a different card, though these were counterbalanced by established recurring transaction patterns at this amount and prior activity in the alternate region. The posterior probability of fraud initially reached 0.693 before customer contact. Following verification, the customer confirmed making this transaction, leading to a calibrated fraud probability of 0.15 and a legitimate verdict. Consequently, a case has been created, the customer has been verified, and a warning has been issued to the customer.
